name: Santaful☆Summer
source:
Tasuku lives alone on the island of St. Christ, where it is summer year-round. He delivers newspapers in the morning and works part-time at a toy store during the day. One day, a girl dropped out of the sky on to him, along with a sleigh full of presents. She was Santa Claus Nicole, and she came from Finland. She had no sense of direction and couldn’t read a map, so she asked for his help in delivering presents since he knew the area well.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/06/20/june-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
